text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even her part-time coworkers, who knew 
little about racing, were shocked to hear 
Ines Fujin was aiming for the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin's dream of giving it her all 
for those around her. Her peers, having 
watched her daily dedication, cheered for 
her from the bottom of their hearts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Mejiro Ryan, the great hope of 
her prestigious family, also carried high 
expectations from those around her. She 
was widely seen as a strong contender to 
win the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Both were promising Umamusume, yet Mejiro 
Ryan wore a conflicted expression as she 
watched Ines Fujin's single-minded 
dedication.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seemed Mejiro Ryan was coming to watch 
the Asahi Hai FS. Knowing her friend would 
be there, Ines Fujin was full of 
motivation.
